method: The independent protocol auditor read every complete prompt and assembled_response for all 52 counterbalanced train-natural cases, in five source batches, before authoring this fragment. Exact prompt and native-trace hashes were checked against the raw records, and the evaluation-model-check receipt bound all 52 rows to the selected model. These are explicit manual case readings, not automatic semantic classifications. SQLite mandatory-dependency wording receives concrete-mechanism credit; a true port-validation reason with a noncausal declaration citation does not meet the frozen genuine-issue definition; trie credit loss is genuine but its separate-product elaboration fails full review. Root and a separate case reader independently agreed on the disputed interpretations before finalization.
